name: Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate
line: Run containers without managing the underlying servers.

free.text: AWS credits; no recurring free Fargate compute allowance

work.math: Known base price for a static site. Logs, overlapping replacement tasks and IP addresses, and extra data transfer can still change the price.
Known base price for a small app API. Logs, overlapping tasks, overlapping IP addresses and data transfer can still change the price.
Known base price for app plus Postgres, including $13.98 for database compute and storage. Backups, logs and data transfer can change the price.
